summary.what_it_does: Cork is a graphical front end for Homebrew, the package manager for macOS. The listing describes it as an intuitive, complete GUI written in SwiftUI that supports all Homebrew features. The page offers several license options: a free self-compiled build, a one-time-purchase User License with automated updates through Homebrew and included support, and a Business License priced by custom contract. The Business License adds a custom update strategy and optional services such as custom feature development, priority support, and compliance certification.
notable: Business License with custom update strategy and contract pricing
caveats: Free self-compiled version has no automated updates and limited support
Business use requires a paid Business License
Paid User License is a one-time purchase; price not stated on page
